# shadcn-nsh

Copy-into-app styled components for [Native Shell (NSH)](https://nsh.dev), built on `nsh/base` and distributed through a shadcn-style registry. The components are copied into the app and belong to it; the theme, the looks and the behavior underneath do not change.

## Commands

- Init an existing NSH app: `npx shadcn-nsh@latest init`
- Add components: `npx shadcn-nsh@latest add <name>` (`--all`, `--dry-run`, `--overwrite`)
- Inspect: `npx shadcn-nsh@latest list`, `view <name>`, `diff [name]`
- Monorepo: `-c apps/web` adds into `packages/ui`
- Default registry: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aningdev/shadcn-nsh/main/public/r/{name}.json`
- Consumer monorepo scaffolding (`create`) is not built.

## Docs

- /docs/getting-started: init, add, list / view / diff, monorepo, local registry.
- /docs/theme: `theme.json` and `finishes.json` are the look; `lib/theme.ts` reads them.
- /docs/components: one page per `registry:ui` item, with Installation, Usage, Examples and API.

## Components

Every page links its base element where `nsh/base` has one: behavior, keyboard support and the full unstyled API live on https://nsh.dev/elements, not here.

- /docs/components/spinner: A turning ring: work going on. → styled on `nsh` View (no base element)
- /docs/components/badge: A small capsule label in neutral, toned, or outline styles. → https://nsh.dev/elements/badge
- /docs/components/button: A button, an icon button, a round button, and a split button. → https://nsh.dev/elements/button
- /docs/components/switch: A switch whose knob springs across a sunk track. → https://nsh.dev/elements/switch
- /docs/components/dialog: A card dialog: Trigger, Content, Title, Description, Footer and Close. → https://nsh.dev/elements/dialog
- /docs/components/toggle: A two-state button, bare or outlined, with a label or an icon. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toggle
- /docs/components/checkbox: A sunk box that fills in citrus, with a check or a dash springing in. → https://nsh.dev/elements/checkbox
- /docs/components/radio-group: A sunk ring that fills in citrus, with a dot growing in — alone or as a choice tile. → https://nsh.dev/elements/radio
- /docs/components/toggle-group: A row or column of toggles on the inset toolbar track. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toggle
- /docs/components/toolbar: An inset track of tools, with groups and hairline separators. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toolbar
- /docs/components/input: A sunk text field — single-line, multiline, masked, or invalid. → https://nsh.dev/elements/input
- /docs/components/number-input: A sunk number field with − / + or stacked chevron steppers. → https://nsh.dev/elements/number-input
- /docs/components/otp-input: One-time code cells that lift out of sunk wells as digits fill in. → https://nsh.dev/elements/otp-input
- /docs/components/time-field: A sunk well for a time of day, one segment at a time. → https://nsh.dev/elements/time-field
- /docs/components/tooltip: A popover-coloured hint bubble on any element's tooltip prop. → https://nsh.dev/elements/tooltip
- /docs/components/popover: A popup panel that grows from its trigger, on the shared menu surface. → https://nsh.dev/elements/popover
- /docs/components/hover-card: A preview card that grows from its trigger, on the shared popover surface. → https://nsh.dev/elements/hover-card
- /docs/components/sheet: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen over a scrim. → https://nsh.dev/elements/sheet
- /docs/components/toast: A raised banner with a title, optional description, action and close. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toast
- /docs/components/alert-dialog: A confirmation card that waits for an action, on the shared dialog look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/alert-dialog
- /docs/components/menu: A menu of items, separators and submenus on the shared menu look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/menu
- /docs/components/context-menu: A menu at the pointer, on the shared menu look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/menu
- /docs/components/select: A list of choices from a field trigger, on the shared listbox look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/select
- /docs/components/combobox: A searchable field with a list of choices, on the shared listbox look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/combobox
- /docs/components/calendar: A month of days to pick a date or a range, on the shared calendar look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/calendar
- /docs/components/date-picker: A calendar in a popup from a field trigger, on the shared listbox look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/date-picker
- /docs/components/tabs: A pill track or underlined row with a traveling indicator. → https://nsh.dev/elements/tabs
- /docs/components/segmented: A sunk track whose raised thumb springs to the selected segment. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toggle
- /docs/components/accordion: List rows that reveal panels with a turning chevron. → https://nsh.dev/elements/accordion
- /docs/components/collapsible: A disclosure row that reveals a panel beneath it. → https://nsh.dev/elements/collapsible
- /docs/components/carousel: Snapping slides with round arrows and a traveling dot pill. → https://nsh.dev/elements/carousel
- /docs/components/link: A text link with underline motion, on the shared nav look. → https://nsh.dev/elements/link
- /docs/components/pagination: A pager of page numbers and chevron arrows. → https://nsh.dev/elements/pagination
- /docs/components/progress: A determinate or indeterminate bar on the shared meter rail. → https://nsh.dev/elements/progress
- /docs/components/meter: A horizontal meter with optional limit marker. → styled on `nsh` View with the progress looks (no base element)
- /docs/components/stat: A label above a value for metric grids. → styled on `nsh` Text and View (no base element)
- /docs/components/status: A dot and label for quiet row or header state. → styled on `nsh` Text and View (no base element)
- /docs/components/slider: A sunk rail with a citrus fill and round thumb. → https://nsh.dev/elements/slider
- /docs/components/avatar: A round picture or named initials on the identity ring. → https://nsh.dev/elements/avatar
- /docs/components/data-table: A card-styled spreadsheet with sorting, selection, and resize. → https://nsh.dev/elements/data-table
- /docs/components/table: A composition table wearing the shared data-table classes. → https://nsh.dev/elements/table
- /docs/components/tree: A card-framed tree with chevron rows and folder icons. → https://nsh.dev/elements/tree
- /docs/components/command: A command palette with search, groups, and shortcut keys. → https://nsh.dev/elements/command
- /docs/components/scrollbar: Hover-reveal scroll bars for scroll views and lists. → https://nsh.dev/elements/scrollbar
- /docs/components/plot: Chart colors, grid, cross line and tooltip for nsh/base/plot. → https://nsh.dev/elements/plot
- /docs/components/resizable: Resize handles with a quiet hairline and a growing thumb. → https://nsh.dev/elements/resizable
- /docs/components/dock-area: Dockable workspace chrome: tabs, splits, and edge docks. → https://nsh.dev/elements/dock
- /docs/components/diff-view: Up/down tints for additions and deletions, with hunk actions. → https://nsh.dev/elements/diff-view
- /docs/components/text-view: Brand links and a streaming caret for Markdown documents. → https://nsh.dev/elements/text-view
- /docs/components/emoji-picker: Gallery look for nsh/base EmojiPicker: tabs, search, tones and preview. → https://nsh.dev/elements/emoji-picker
- /docs/components/editor: Rich document typography and code editor pass-through. → https://nsh.dev/elements/rich-editor
- /docs/components/color-picker: Area, sliders, joined fields, swatches, and popover trigger. → https://nsh.dev/elements/color-picker

## Elsewhere

- Base behavior and elements: https://nsh.dev/elements
- Base module: https://nsh.dev/modules/nsh-base
- Component sources in this repository: `packages/ui/<name>.tsx`
- Demos that the pages preview: `apps/docs/demos/<name>.tsx`; reference pages for the render comparison are `apps/docs/demos/<name>.ref.tsx`.
